research.name: anidoodle
research.note: Agent skill and Node engine that draws illustrations and animations in 31 hand-made styles from deterministic code, each able to film itself being drawn.

effects: pictures that draw themselves stroke by stroke in the order of the medium (woodblock keyblock then colour blocks, pixel art flat shapes then shading)
31 code-drawn illustration styles such as scratchboard, single-line engraving, embroidery, risograph and sumi-e
form companion mascot that watches typing, covers its eyes at the password field and cheers on submit
